2) We'll push a cleaned sample press release + short testimonial copy for review (target: 48hr turnaround).
3) Legal teams exchange redlines and we converge on a final short clause for the Order Form (no blanket rights; customer approval required).

Thanks — looking to keep this moving so procurement can complete the order form.

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the note. Quick answers from our side:
- PR lead: Samira Khan (cc'd). Legal/GC is Jordan Lee (cc'd). Both should be on review for any press language or logo placement.
- Embargo: we are likely to have an internal regulatory clearance window tied to our Q2 product announcement; earliest safe public mention is currently Apr 15, 2028. That date may shift but plan around it.
- Logo use: we cannot allow use of the Brightlane primary logo on vendor landing pages or homepages without explicit, case-by-case approval. Co-branded materials or joint press releases are fine with prior written approval.
- Quotes: we are comfortable with a short executive quote (we prefer to provide the final text rather than granting open-ended testimonial rights).

Jordan / Samira — feel free to add specifics. If you can return sample language for the Order Form (one short clause) and a simple approval SLA (e.g., 48–72 hours turnaround), that would be ideal.

Elena

Naomi / Marissa —

Thanks for looping us in. From a legal standpoint we prefer the following high-level edits to the publicity / publicity-related Order Form language (summary here; redline attached):

Key legal points (summary):
- Prior written approval required: Any use of Brightlane's name, logo or trademarks in press releases, marketing materials, vendor websites, or promotional collateral requires prior written approval from Brightlane's PR/legal.
- Testimonial allowance: Limited to a single short testimonial excerpt provided by Brightlane (maximum 150 characters) unless otherwise agreed in writing. Redwood may request an expanded testimonial but it must be separately approved.
- Logo placement limits: Logos may only be used in co-branded assets or case studies with prior approval; no placement on vendor homepages or product landing pages without explicit sign-off.
- Embargo: Redwood agrees not to publicly announce the relationship or disclose the Brightlane name in marketing or sales materials until Brightlane provides written confirmation that the embargo has lifted.
- Records & approval trail: All approvals must be stored in the shared Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3BrightlaneApprovals) and will be considered the official authorization.
- Remedies: If an unauthorized use occurs, Redwood agrees to immediate takedown and correction; repeated violations may be subject to remedies per the MSA.

We attach a marked-up MSA snippet for your counsel to review (Brightlane_MSA_redlines_v2.docx).

Operational ask: Please include a short approval field in Salesforce/HubSpot or as a Drive doc so we have a timestamped record of what was approved and who signed off. If you rely on DocuSign for order routing, please include a link after approvals are obtained (we prefer a DocuSign envelope for the final Order Form).

Happy to discuss on a call if helpful — Jordan available Mon/Tue next week.

Jordan Lee
General Counsel | Brightlane Health
jordan.lee@brightlane.com
